Engineering, branding and supplies for Zambia
From roads and buildings to billboards, print and ICT: one Luanshya team, working for public institutions and private clients since 2018.
One company, four ways to help

We provide engineering, construction and branding services to parastatals, public works agencies, municipalities and commercial private clients, and keep clients informed so every project stays on schedule and within budget.
Project planning and management, civil and structural engineering, roads in gravel, paving blocks, concrete and bitumen with their drainage, and residential, commercial and institutional buildings.
Billboards and banners, storefront and office front branding, show booths, exhibition stands, pull-up banners and teardrop flags. Safety, site and road signage, worksuit and vehicle branding.
Company profiles, brochures, business stationery and books, event backdrops, name tags, lanyards, custom shirt prints, hoodies, caps and replica jerseys.
Product labels and stickers, CAD drawings, concept renders, pattern cut-outs and illustrations. Office stationery and consumables, and ICT software and hardware installations.

Construction project planning and management, feasibility studies, environmental impact assessments, contract management, supervision, site inspections, quality control and assurance, and construction labour hire.
